high_level_description: The image depicts a scene from a demonstration of a funeral ceremony with a Buddhist priest in Tokyo in 2017. The central focus is on a robot named Pepper, which is dressed in traditional Buddhist attire, including a black robe and a white collar. Pepper has a humanoid head with a screen displaying Japanese characters, suggesting it is programmed to interact with visitors. In the background, two individuals are standing near a table adorned with various ceremonial items such as vases and what appears to be a ceremonial bowl.
